jobs.title: Supervisory Pharmacy Technician
jobs.description: **The salary range listed on this announcement only reflects the General Schedule incorporating Rest of U.S. basic pay. Upon selection, the salary will be adjusted to include the locality adjustment for the specific location.** Major duties performed but are not limited to the following: Responsible for administering human resources actions and personnel matters and dealing effectively with employees and union representatives. Maintains National Pharmacy Technician Certification. Prepares the tour of duty for the VISN CCC Pharmacy technicians. Responsible for approving and denying leave requests, including but not limited to annual and sick leave, for VISN CCC Pharmacy technicians. Ensures compliance with established VA and pharmacy policies and procedures. Performs quality control of pharmacy technicians' work and calls. Completes job performance evaluations, recommendations for awards, and/or disciplinary actions for the VISN CCC Pharmacy technicians and makes recommendations to the VISN CCC Pharmacist Supervisor. Participates in the creation of VISN CCC Pharmacy Services standard operating procedures. Assists in the interview process and selection of VISN CCC Pharmacy technicians. Conducts technician meetings/huddles to assure proper updates of departmental and hospital communications. Encourages pharmacy technicians to report actual and/or potential medication errors or adverse events and participates in medical center and pharmacy service quality improvement initiatives to promote patient safety. Work Schedule: Monday - Friday, Rotational variable shifts, 7:00am to 7:00PM PST. Virtual: This is a virtual position. Functional Statement #: 000000 Relocation/Recruitment Incentives: Not Authorized Permanent Change of Station (PCS): Not Authorized
